summary: Frites uit Zuyd is a Dutch maker of fresh, chilled pre-fried potato fries from Agria potatoes grown in the Netherlands, supplied to food service, wholesale, retail and events. Its address is in Almere, Flevoland, and its website carries the caption "Amsterdam, since 2013". It offers four cuts, including 8.7 mm thin.
products: Fresh pre-fried fries, never frozen, made to order
Food service: 10 kg reusable crates, packed open in grease-free paper
Retail: 450 g recyclable packs in thick and thin cuts
markets: Wholesale, including Hanos, Bidfood, VHC Jongens and Actifood
Greater Amsterdam, Utrecht, 't Gooi, Flevoland and Noord-Holland
Limburg, Belgian Limburg and the coast from Scheveningen to Den Helder
facts: Fries are cooled to 2 °C in an 80-metre cooling tunnel
Potatoes: underwater weight of at least 380 g and tuber size over 58 mm
Potatoes grown in Limburg, the Flevopolder, Zeeland and the Haarlemmermeer
Daily delivery Monday to Saturday with its own refrigerated trucks
The factory runs fully electric and gas-free
limitations: The website does not publish the legal form, ownership, employee numbers, production capacity or annual tonnage.
It does not say what began in 2013 or confirm that the Almere address is the factory.
The number of growers and export markets beyond Belgian Limburg are not published.
